name: Cover: hero
description: A website-hero cover: top-bar furniture, an anchored kicker, a big title, a lede, three KPI numbers and a glow on the right. A title-only cover would lose the weight of stating claim, evidence and scale on one slide.

brand.hint: top bar left: deck or series name, filled automatically from the series part of the story title (before the colon)

meta.hint: top bar right: occasion or date, filled automatically from the first clause of occasion (up to 10 characters)

kicker.hint: small heading after the anchor, 4 to 12 characters

title.hint: claim headline, 1 to 2 lines, up to 16 characters; *keyword* marks an emphasis

subtitle.hint: lede, 1 to 2 lines, up to 50 characters

stat-1.hint: KPI: a big number with a label, or a short phrase

stat-3.hint: same as above; leave empty when there is no third

brand.value: Confirm the story before the slides

subtitle.value: Six decks averaged four rounds, three on layout alone; confirm the story first and they vanish.
